parsing_traps.detail: The Portfolio Statement uses alternating pages: odd pages (130,132,134...) contain description/tenure/location columns; even pages (131,133,135...) contain value columns with NO label column. This is the defined facing-page positional split in REFERENCE.md §2 — the deterministic adapter cannot handle it. Properties were extracted via LLM by reading paired pages. Confirmed: value table first column is blank for every data row.

Despite MLT operating in 9 currencies (SGD, AUD, CNY, HKD, INR, JPY, MYR, KRW, VND), the Portfolio Statement presents ALL values in S$'000 (SGD), converted at closing rates. currency field set to SGD for all properties.
Valuation jumped from S$55.1m (FY2024) to S$188m (FY2025) due to redevelopment completion. Not a data error.

The S$13,156,611k is the base; add asset retirement obligation asset (S$477k) + lease liabilities (S$87,795k) = Total investment properties S$13,244,883k per Note 14(a). Held-for-sale (Note 15) S$47,102k is separate.
